comment: Smoke test preset (scripts/smoke-mac.sh passes it as ASKFILES_PRESETS_FILE): one tier for every machine with the small test models of the cloud environment and CI. Starting values only; answer quality is irrelevant here.

tiers.label: Smoke test
tiers.comment: Starting values for the smoke test only. all-minilm reads 256 word pieces, so chunks stay small; threshold 0 so its low scores still return sources.
tiers.systemPrompt: Answer only from the provided context. Cite the source document for what you say. If the context does not contain the answer, say that you do not know.
